what: FYI, edits in your crate (no live codegen window): single flight so concurrent builds of one Memo compile a shared function once (3 proc macros reaching syn: 1 compile, not 3). New crates/blaze-codegen/src/flight.rs (Flights table inside Memo, Memo::flights()); driver.rs dev() and release() claim store misses (dev by stored key, release by blob key, release templates now Memo::put under blob_key.0), land, let go, then wait; new Stats::flown; tests in driver/tests/flight.rs. Design: docs/v2/plan/lanes/compile-time-sched/notes.md. Open for you: (1) release summaries are still prepared+summarized per build before claims; (2) Spec settings hash the whole Policy id, so units whose closures get different per-package overrides key syn apart and compile it once each; (3) fold groups and run_later/compile_one do not claim; (4) nothing in the daemon calls Memo::retain, the memo only grows.
